text: I had a medical certificate prepared for my driver's license renewal. It's still the same as before, 150 THB, and I'm grateful for the price. All I had to do was take my blood pressure, self-report my weight and height, and submit my license for renewal. There were six locals in the waiting room with the same request, so it was tough for the doctor who was working alone. I wonder if this place is popular with locals? Or was it just a coincidence?
